description: Search the TradingAgentStack directory of AI trading tools (broker MCP servers, trading and data APIs, bots, frameworks) by name, market or feature. Optional filters: category slug, can_trade_live, has_paper.

can_trade_live.description: Only tools that can place real-money orders

category.description: Category slug, e.g. broker_mcp, data_api, ai_bot_platform

has_paper.description: Only tools with a documented paper/demo/testnet mode

query.description: Words to match, e.g. 'options paper alpaca'

name: search_tools
